description_en: Call the DeleteIoTCloudConnectorBackhaulRoute operation to delete the backhaul route of a cloud connector instance
description_zh: 调用DeleteIoTCloudConnetorBackhaulRoute接口删除当前云连接器实例绑定VPC后的回程路由
kebab_example: aliyun iotcc delete-iot-cloud-connetor-backhaul-route --iot-cloud-connector-id iotcc-bp1odcab8tmno0hdq0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteIoTCloudConnetorBackhaulRoute

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cloud connector instance
parameters.name: iot_cloud_connector_id

parameters.help_en:
A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a unique value from your client for this parameter. ClientToken must consist of only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: Performs a dry run. The system checks the request for potential issues, including missing parameters, incorrect formatting, and service limits. The system does not delete the backhaul route. If the check fails, an error message is returned. If the check passes, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.

false (default): Sends the request. If the request passes the check, an HTTP 2xx status code is returned and the backhaul route is deleted
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会删除当前云连接器实例绑定VPC后的回程路由。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接删除云连接器实例绑定VPC后的回程路由
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region where the cloud connector instance is deployed.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/313836.html operation to get the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
云连接器实例所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/313836.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id
